newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 14.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 14.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:

* On Friday, the Dow Industrials fell 148.36 points, or 2.27 percent, to close at 6391.69 points after a surprising jump in wholesale prices forced investors to recast their outlook for inflation and interest rates.

* Bank Indonesia would issue a new scheme which would enable the central bank, under certain conditions, to ask registered public accountants to conduct special investigations on information submitted by banks, Bisnis Indonesia newspaper quoted central bank director Hendrobudiyanto as saying.
* On Friday, the Jakarta composite index rose 1.59 points to close at 637.15 points.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,404.00/04.50 at 0125 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,404.30/05.30.
* Sampoerna on market talk its first quarter sales are likely to be disappointing.

* Bank Pikko on a Bisnis Indonesia report that trading of its shares on the stock exchange should not be allowed to resume unless alleged irregularities which pushed it up by 200 percent early last week are cleared up.
The Jakarta stock exchange suspended trading of Pikko in late trading last Tuesday, but allowed to resume trading in afternoon session on Thursday.
* Poultry breeding firm Multibreeder as it was allowed to resume trading on Friday after being suspended earlier following a 31.25 percent rise.
* Indosat on reports it planned to sell most of its stake in communications firm Satelindo.
